</div>

## Import



Config aggregate compliance pack can be imported using the composite id, e.g. `account_group_id#compliance_pack_id`.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Config/aggregateCompliancePack:AggregateCompliancePack example ca-Zp9EiU7Pa4Vy0lFFm8XM#cp-VNsYhja10ewnInqtc0qp
```

> `accountGroupId` is immutable: changing it forces resource replacement. The `managedRuleIdentifier` and per-rule `compliancePackId` fields are not echoed back by the Describe API, so drift detection for those fields is limited; their values are preserved from the Terraform configuration on read.



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
